# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9

## Reflection
Men, we often wake up with the weight of the world on our shoulders—bills, bosses, battles at home. But notice what God told Joshua as he stood on the edge of the Promised Land: not "be strong" alone, but *be strong and courageous*. Strength without courage is just muscle; courage without strength is just a wish. God didn't promise Joshua an easy path—He promised His presence. That changes everything. The enemy wants you to believe you fight alone, that your back is against the wall. But the Commander of Heaven's armies is already on the field with you. Your job isn't to manufacture power; it's to obey in faith while He secures the victory. Stand firm, warrior. The ground you walk on today is holy because He walks it with you.

## Daily Challenge
Before you step out the door, drop to your knees for 30 seconds of prayer, then do 25 pushups as a physical act of surrender—offering your strength to His will today.
